description: Working-day maths with each country's (and state's) public holidays: add or subtract N business days to a date (payment terms, delivery, legal deadlines), or count business days between two dates. Custom weekend (e.g. Fri-Sat). Returns the holidays that were skipped. < 50 ms. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/business-days.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, BG, US

end.description: Or an end date YYYY-MM-DD to count business days between

name: business_days
title: Business Days Calculator API - add working days, count between dates
